productArea.name: Data modeling
productArea.scope: Create and edit models and metrics, their history and actions, and browse the data reference. Admin pages, including table metadata and segments, query building, chart settings, and dashboards are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Browse then Models, open a model, and use its detail, actions, and editing views.
Choose Browse then Metrics, open or create a metric, and check its history.
Open the data reference to browse databases, tables, and fields.
